purpose: Backpacks, totes, crossbody bags, and gym bags for campus, gym, streetwear, clean, and travel outfit builds.

candidates.title: Herschel Little America Backpack Black 25L
candidates.fitNotes: Classic roll-closure top, 25L capacity, laptop sleeve, clean all-black design
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Herschel Little America is the definitive campus backpack; all-black colorway is the most versatile

candidates.title: JanSport Right Pack Backpack Black 31L
candidates.fitNotes: Padded laptop sleeve, front utility pocket, dual side water bottle pockets, lifetime warranty
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Most recognized affordable campus backpack; essential budget option for the bag category

candidates.title: The North Face Borealis Backpack TNF Black 28L
candidates.fitNotes: FlexVent suspension, 28L, padded laptop compartment, water-resistant base

candidates.title: Telfar Shopping Bag Medium Black
candidates.fitNotes: Vegan leather, double handles plus shoulder strap, embossed TC logo, unisex silhouette
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Telfar is the defining streetwear-meets-accessible bag brand; medium size is the hero product

candidates.title: Carhartt WIP Delta Shell Backpack Black 20L
candidates.fitNotes: Recycled nylon shell, Carhartt WIP branding, clean minimal paneling
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Carhartt WIP bag fills the workwear-to-streetwear bag gap; recognizable for masc street builds

candidates.title: Fjallraven Kanken Backpack Ox Red 16L
candidates.fitNotes: Vinylon F fabric, square boxy silhouette, front zip pocket, very recognizable handle at top
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Fjallraven Kanken is universally recognized campus bag; red colorway adds visual interest to outfit builds

candidates.title: Eastpak Padded Pak'r Backpack Black 24L
candidates.fitNotes: Single main compartment, fleece-lined front pocket, padded back panel, 30-year guarantee
candidates.reasonForInclusion: European campus/street staple; budget black backpack to complement Herschel/JanSport options

candidates.title: Coach Tabby 26 Shoulder Bag Chalk
candidates.fitNotes: Pillow leather exterior, turnlock closure, adjustable shoulder strap, structured silhouette
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Coach Tabby is the most desired accessible luxury fem bag of the current era; chalk color is the hero colorway

candidates.title: Lululemon Everywhere Belt Bag 1L Black
candidates.fitNotes: 1L waist/crossbody bag, water-resistant exterior, adjustable strap, very clean minimal design
candidates.reasonForInclusion: The most popular belt bag of the decade; fills the gym/campus crossbody bag slot perfectly

candidates.title: Nike Brasilia 9.5 Training Duffel Bag Black Medium
candidates.fitNotes: Main zip compartment, separate shoe pocket, padded shoulder strap, swoosh branding
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Most popular budget gym duffel; essential for gym outfit builds needing a bag

candidates.title: Madewell Transport Tote Bag True Black
candidates.fitNotes: Top-zip leather tote, shoulder and cross-body carry options, structured silhouette, 13in laptop fits
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Madewell Transport fills clean/campus tote gap; leather construction elevates campus outfit

candidates.title: Aritzia Super Puff Mini Tote Bag Black
candidates.fitNotes: Quilted puffer exterior, top handles and detachable strap, very compact silhouette
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Aritzia Super Puff is a viral product; puffer mini bag is a seasonal must-have for fem streetwear/campus

candidates.title: Baggu Small Nylon Crescent Bag Oat
candidates.fitNotes: Compact crescent silhouette, adjustable crossbody strap, clean minimal design
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Baggu crescent bag is the defining Gen-Z campus bag; light oat/cream color adds softness to outfits

candidates.title: Fjallraven Ulvo Hip Pack Small Black
candidates.fitNotes: Water-resistant G-1000 fabric, waist or shoulder carry, 2L capacity
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Fjallraven hip pack fills the utility/travel sling bag gap for masc outdoor-to-street builds

candidates.title: Marc Jacobs The Snapshot Mini Camera Bag Black
candidates.fitNotes: Mini crossbody camera bag, triple compartment, silver hardware, distinctive block logo
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Marc Jacobs Snapshot is the most recognized accessible luxury mini bag; fills the premium fem crossbody gap
